mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Every current full-suite failure is classified as a current regression, archived-expectation conflict, or environment issue; historical tests stop reading mutable current release metadata; the v0.4.x gate count matches execution and no unknown diagnostic failure is hidden.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Failure inventory, regression-lane schema and migration, focused gate, and full-suite result.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Lilies persists a delivery mode distinct from workflow or chat shape; Quick, Guided, and Governed policies have explicit API semantics and legacy applications receive a deterministic default.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Schema migration, storage and API tests, policy matrix, and backward-compatibility test.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Quick and Guided publication can proceed with explicit missing or stale evidence warnings; Governed publication blocks only under an explicitly configured hard policy; behavior-affecting edits retain prior evidence as stale with change context and a revalidation action.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Publish-policy and stale-evidence lifecycle tests, API payloads, frontend contract checks, and Browser observation when a supported provider is available.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Each failed acceptance case exposes structured repair guidance and can open and apply a one-click Builder Team workflow-edit preview carrying workflow, node, trace, and failure context; unsupported or failed previews remain explicit.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Repair API/context/apply tests, frontend failure-state contract checks, resulting draft hash change, and Browser observation when a supported provider is available.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Common model, HTTP or tool, and Loop blocks use schema-driven human-readable controls by default, retain raw JSON as an expert view, save canonical WorkflowSpec values, and affect runtime behavior.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Block-schema/frontend-contract tests, persistence round trip, runtime behavior assertions, lint/build, and Browser observation when a supported provider is available.

mandatory_tasks.acceptance: The complete non-technical journey is implemented across mode selection, evidence state, acceptance progress, repair, common-block configuration, and publication policy; API integration, frontend contracts, lint/build, focused regression, and full-suite classification pass. Browser-level usability, crash, console, screenshot, and overlap claims require actual Browser evidence; if the supported provider is unavailable they remain blocked_by_environment evidence debt and cannot stop unrelated report implementation.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: End-to-end API flow, frontend source contracts, lint/build, reproducible target environment, focused/full regression classification, evidence-debt claim ceiling, and fresh closure audit; desktop/mobile Browser evidence only supports a browser_verified claim when actually available.
